scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Optimal quasi-triangle modulus for the specified eight-ray, centrally symmetric, strictly positive four-weight conic spline on real R^2; all twelve ratio terms essential.
scientific_integrity.computational_scope: 4096 exact-rational octagonal parameter sets, 12 strict witness sets, 1728 hexagonal control sets; finite tests do not prove the continuum assertion.
scientific_integrity.limitations: No claims for vanishing weights, arbitrary fans or dimensions above two. A complete independent literature priority check and independent mathematical audit are not provided.
scientific_integrity.method: Analytical planar support-face principle, exact polygon chord-ray crossings, strict rational witness comparisons; auxiliary exact-rational checker.

title: Exact twelve-branch quasi-triangle modulus of four-weight octagonal conic splines
